import sys
raw_path, out_path = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
keys = {'rs8176719','rs8176743','rs8176746','rs8176747','rs8176749','rs8176750','rs8176720','rs8176693','rs8176668','rs1053878','rs2519093','rs41302905','rs7853989','rs8176704','rs8176718','rs8176717','rs8176716','rs8176732','rs8176733','rs8176734','rs8176751'}
with open(raw_path) as f:
    header = f.readline().rstrip('\n').split('\t')
    rows = [line.rstrip('\n').split('\t') for line in f if line.strip()]
idx_iid = header.index('IID')
selected = []
for i, h in enumerate(header):
    base = h.rsplit('_', 1)[0] if '_' in h else h
    vals = [r[i] for r in rows]
    variable = len(set(vals)) > 1
    if base in keys or (variable and (base.startswith('rs81766') or base.startswith('rs81767'))):
        selected.append(i)
with open(out_path, 'w') as out:
    out.write('marker\tcounted_allele\t' + '\t'.join(r[idx_iid] for r in rows) + '\n')
    for i in selected:
        h = header[i]
        base, allele = h.rsplit('_', 1) if '_' in h else (h, '')
        out.write(base + '\t' + allele + '\t' + '\t'.join(r[i] for r in rows) + '\n')
